searchText: <@199561711278227457> I have an image for the next devnet: https://github.com/prysmaticlabs/prysm/tree/peerDAS-revert-failing-commit-develop The name of the branch is strange because this branch contains the `peerDAS` branch + the revert of a commit on our `develop` branch, unrelated to peerDAS but which makes some issues at the Fulu fork. (And because peerDAS runs at the Fulu fork, there is some issues if I don't revert this commit for peerDAS...) Tests done, with **Prysm only**: - Standard run starting at Deneb: ✅ - Start only three quarters of the nodes for 10 epochs (finalizing devnet), then start the missing quarter and wait all nodes are synced to the head: ✅ - Start only half of the nodes for 10 epochs (**un**finalizing devnet), then start the other half and wait all nodes are synced to the head, and the network is finalizing: ✅ - Run with a node withholding 64 out of 128 columns when proposing a block, forcing other super nodes to reconstruct missing columns: ✅ - Run a node which forks itself every 20 slots, then try to rejoin the main fork: (Some orphaned blocks if proposing just after a forced fork, but ✅) Validator custody is **not** implemented. If other clients have an image I can interop with, please share 🙂 My kurtosis config for information: ```yaml participants_matrix: el: - el_type: geth cl: - cl_type: prysm cl_image: prysm-bn-custom-image:latest vc_image: prysm-vc-custom-image:latest cl_max_mem: 4096 count: 2 cl_extra_params: - --minimum-peers-per-subnet=1 - --subscribe-all-subnets - --log-format=json vc_extra_params: - --log-format=json - cl_type: prysm count: 1 cl_image: prysm-bn-custom-image:latest vc_image: prysm-vc-custom-image:latest cl_max_mem: 4096 cl_extra_params: - --minimum-peers-per-subnet=1 - --log-format=json - --data-columns-withhold-count=64 vc_extra_params: - --log-format=json - cl_type: prysm count: 1 cl_image: prysm-bn-custom-image:latest vc_image: prysm-vc-custom-image:latest cl_max_mem: 4096 cl_extra_params: - --data-columns-ignore-slot-multiple=20 - --minimum-peers-per-subnet=1 - --log-format=json vc_extra_params: - --log-format=json network_params: seconds_per_slot: 4 electra_fork_epoch: 1 fulu_fork_epoch: 2 snooper_enabled: true global_log_level: debug additional_services: - dora - spamoor_blob - prometheus_grafana dora_params: image: ethpandaops/dora:fulu-support ethereum_metrics_exporter_enabled: true ``` This is amaazingg 😄 Shall i also trigger one of our longer range tests? just leave the network up for a few days and see what happens? Before launching a new devnet, I think each team should locally test if its own client works with other clients. (At least I would like to test locally Prysm+LH, Prysm+Teku, Prysm+Nimbus... before confidently launching a new devnet.) ah i meant just a prysm devnet on kurtosis, if i do it on our kubernetes cluster then its not tied to someone turning off their laptop or whatever so cost of trying it is negligible OK I see. Well, if you wish to do it with Prysm only now I'm happy with that! But yeah it would indeed be nice to start doing some interop tests too 😄 Note I use `seconds_per_slot: 4` .Not sure we should use that for a long running devnet, but at least, if an issue should happen, it happens faster 🙂 So in the kurtosis config for information: ``` --data-columns-withhold-count=64 ``` is the "shoot in my own foot flag #1": The node will only broadcasts columns 64 to 123, forcing other super nodes to reconstruct. ``` --data-columns-ignore-slot-multiple=20 ``` is the "shoot in my own foot flag #2": At slot 0, 20, 40, 60, .... the node will voluntary ignore all incoming data columns and so consider the block as unavailable. If it has to propose at a slot let say 21, it will probably build its block on the block at slot 19 (because block at slot 20 is unavailable to it.) Eventually, it will send data columns by root RPC requests, then rejoin the main fork. Here is an extreme case: Data columns at slot 100 are voluntary ignored by node `4-geth-prysm`. This node has to propose 4 blocks in a raw starting at slot 104. It does, but because the first one is based on block at slot 99 (since block at slot 100 is considered unavailable), all these blocks are orphaned. Eventually, it rejoins the main fork, and proposes canonical blocks at slots 111 and 113 Nice, this is a good test for recovery - our devnets forked a few times from this

excerpts.content:
<@199561711278227457> I have an image for the next devnet: https://github.com/prysmaticlabs/prysm/tree/peerDAS-revert-failing-commit-develop

The name of the branch is strange because this branch contains the `peerDAS` branch + the revert of a commit on our `develop` branch, unrelated to peerDAS but which makes some issues at the Fulu fork. (And because peerDAS runs at the Fulu fork, there is some issues if I don't revert this commit for peerDAS...)

Tests done, with **Prysm only**:
- Standard run starting at Deneb: ✅
- Start only three quarters of the nodes for 10 epochs (finalizing devnet), then start the missing quarter and wait all nodes are synced to the head:  ✅
- Start only half of the nodes for 10 epochs (**un**finalizing devnet), then start the other half and wait all nodes are synced to the head, and the network is finalizing:  ✅
- Run with a node withholding 64 out of 128 columns when proposing a block, forcing other super nodes to reconstruct missing columns: ✅
- Run a node which forks itself every 20 slots, then try to rejoin the main fork: (Some orphaned blocks if proposing just after a forced fork, but ✅)

Validator custody is **not** implemented.

If other clients have an image I can interop with, please share 🙂

excerpts.author: manunlp
excerpts.content:
My kurtosis config for information:
```yaml
participants_matrix:
  el:
    - el_type: geth
  cl:
      - cl_type: prysm
        cl_image: prysm-bn-custom-image:latest
        vc_image: prysm-vc-custom-image:latest
        cl_max_mem: 4096
        count: 2
        cl_extra_params:
          - --minimum-peers-per-subnet=1
          - --subscribe-all-subnets
          - --log-format=json
        vc_extra_params:
          - --log-format=json
      - cl_type: prysm
        count: 1
        cl_image: prysm-bn-custom-image:latest
        vc_image: prysm-vc-custom-image:latest
        cl_max_mem: 4096
        cl_extra_params:
          - --minimum-peers-per-subnet=1
          - --log-format=json
          - --data-columns-withhold-count=64
        vc_extra_params:
          - --log-format=json
      - cl_type: prysm
        count: 1
        cl_image: prysm-bn-custom-image:latest
        vc_image: prysm-vc-custom-image:latest
        cl_max_mem: 4096
        cl_extra_params:
          - --data-columns-ignore-slot-multiple=20
          - --minimum-peers-per-subnet=1
          - --log-format=json
        vc_extra_params:
          - --log-format=json
network_params:
  seconds_per_slot: 4
  electra_fork_epoch: 1
  fulu_fork_epoch: 2
snooper_enabled: true
global_log_level: debug
additional_services:
  - dora
  - spamoor_blob
  - prometheus_grafana
dora_params:
  image: ethpandaops/dora:fulu-support
ethereum_metrics_exporter_enabled: true
```
